title: The Groundwater Monitoring Infrastructure Assessment Dataset, Nkhotakota - Malawi (2022)
text: Groundwater Monitoring Infrastructure Assessment Dataset (2022) open dataset published BASEflow Malawi. dataset contains field observations collected assessment groundwater monitoring infrastructure Nkhotakota District, Malawi 2022. includes information monitoring well characteristics, groundwater level measurements, monitoring equipment, site accessibility, infrastructure condition, community awareness, recommended maintenance rehabilitation actions. dataset captures key attributes groundwater monitoring sites, including well depth, static groundwater level, measurement methods, level logger barometric logger availability, equipment condition, site accessibility, monitoring well purpose, vandalism risks, nearby water source types, infrastructure improvement recommendations. Together, data provide comprehensive assessment operational status maintenance needs groundwater monitoring infrastructure study area. dataset supports evidence-based groundwater management can used evaluate condition monitoring infrastructure, identify maintenance priorities, strengthen groundwater monitoring networks, support sustainable groundwater resource management Malawi. Potential Use Cases dataset suitable use : Government ministries water authorities responsible groundwater monitoring water resources management. Researchers universities conducting studies hydrogeology, groundwater monitoring, climate resilience, environmental management. Development partners non-governmental organizations implementing groundwater water security programmes. Hydrogeologists groundwater professionals assessing monitoring network performance infrastructure condition. GIS analysts data scientists developing spatial analyses, dashboards, predictive models groundwater monitoring. Policy makers supporting groundwater governance, infrastructure planning, investment decisions. Students undertaking research groundwater, environmental science, civil engineering, water resources. Organizations contributing Sustainable Development Goal 6 (Clean Water Sanitation), integrated water resources management, climate adaptation initiatives.

code: library(gwinfraassess)  # Visualization: Improvement Recommendations # libraries library(dplyr) library(tidyr) library(ggplot2) library(stringr)  #filter rows where improvement_plan is NA or null improve_plot <-   gwinfraassess %>%   filter(!is.na(improvement_plan),          improvement_plan != "") %>%   separate_rows(improvement_plan, sep = ",") %>%   mutate(improvement_plan = str_trim(improvement_plan)) %>%   count(improvement_plan, sort = TRUE) #Plot the results ggplot(improve_plot,        aes(x = reorder(improvement_plan, n),            y = n)) +   geom_col() +   coord_flip() +   labs(     title = "Recommended Improvement Actions",     x = NULL,     y = "Number of Monitoring Wells"   ) +   theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
